jira.application-roles.constraints: Validate bounded complete native role array before local pagination. Preserve optional groups/defaultGroups, native booleans and signed int32 metrics; negative metrics are not converted to zero or independently interpreted as unlimited. jira.assign.constraints: One exact active assignable user; no arbitrary user or privileged fallback.

jira.attachment.constraints: One exact attachment selector; bounded filename/size plus optional MIME/creation text. Native metadata may omit its ID; any supplied ID must match. Remote content/self/thumbnail URLs and author objects are omitted; no binary retrieval or issue association is inferred.

jira.attachment-archive.constraints: Published experimental raw expansion; bounded typed entries, exact entry indexes and optional sizes/text. Local pagination covers only returned entries; remote totalEntryCount and completeness remain separately explicit when known. No invented remote paging, extraction or downloads.

jira.attachment-archive-summary.constraints: Published experimental human expansion; only validated numeric identity and optional name/media type/entry count are projected. Opaque entries remain unconsumed; no complete archive or binary-content claim.

jira.attachment-settings.constraints: Native enabled flag plus optional uploadLimit and the existing local maxBytes ceiling; missing limits stay unknown. This read never grants upload authority; the established writer still requires a known bound.

jira.avatars.constraints: Closed project/issuetype and exact owner-ID selectors; bounded system/custom metadata and local pagination. No universal-avatar upload/create/delete or image/remote URL access.

jira.backlog-move-issues.constraints: 1..50 unique issue keys admitted through existing issue-template checks before one POST; each current sprint membership is independently read as null. Batch failures remain uncertain; no replay or ranking.

jira.board.constraints: Selected board, sprint or epic with typed bounded projection and explicit native pagination where present; malformed/oversized pages fail closed. No ranking, board configuration mutation or implicit completion from item count.

jira.board-backlog.constraints: Selected board, sprint or epic with typed bounded projection and explicit native pagination where present; malformed/oversized pages fail closed. No ranking, board configuration mutation or implicit completion from item count.

jira.component.constraints: One exact positive decimal int64 resource ID and bounded supported field projection; remote self URLs are not trusted links.

jira.components.constraints: One bound project; complete bounded native array is validated before local startAt/maxResults pagination. Oversized source arrays fail closed; no silent truncation.

jira.create.constraints: One issue through metadata, formal-template/source and authority enforcement; draft composition reuses this operation.

jira.create-component.constraints: Closed name/description/lead/assignee fields in the selected current project; precise string ID and independent identity/project/field GET confirmation. No archive/delete/project move.

jira.create-fields.constraints: Bounded typed create-field metadata for one project/type; not arbitrary field/schema access.

jira.create-project.constraints: Closed key/name/lead/type and supported optional create fields, including explicit native projectTemplateKey; exact numeric creation identity and independent readable-field GET confirmation. HTTP 409 may mean partial creation and never permits replay. Template/board/workflow identity is not claimed as independently verified.

jira.create-version.constraints: Closed name/description/calendar date/released/archived fields; project ID must serialize as an exact safe native number. Independent identity/project/readable-field GET confirmation. No delete/merge/replace.

jira.create-worklog.constraints: One issue-bound POST with explicit positive safe seconds and zoned start; fixed adjustEstimate=leave. Optional native comment and exact role/group visibility. Saved issue-template admission uses observed/calculated aggregate time, never missing-as-zero. Exact acknowledged ID and independent bound issue/worklog GET; uncertain effects are not replayed. Other estimate adjustment modes and author selection are unsupported.

jira.dashboard.constraints: One exact string int64 dashboard identity with bounded id/name projection; remote self/navigation URLs are omitted. No gadgets, properties or dashboard administration.

jira.dashboards.constraints: Visible dashboard id/name projection only; bounded native startAt/maxResults pagination with validated totals. Remote continuation URLs are never followed; no gadget/layout or write support.

jira.delete-attachment.constraints: One exact issue-bound attachment DELETE after matching reviewed native filename/byte size and independently readable attachment metadata. One effect only; after acknowledged success require the same readable canonical issue and complete valid attachment-list absence. Bare404, permission loss or incomplete readback never confirms deletion; known resource receipts survive uncertainty. No binary retrieval, source-path input or upload changes.

jira.delete-comment.constraints: One exact issue-bound comment DELETE after matching the reviewed native body and visibility. Omitted reviewed visibility explicitly means unrestricted. Same canonical parent remains readable; only bounded complete native comment-list absence after acknowledgement confirms removal. Bare404, unreadable or contradictory response remains uncertain, without replay. No bulk deletion or arbitrary issue/comment relocation.

jira.delete-worklog.constraints: One exact issue-bound worklog DELETE after matching reviewed native seconds, start instant, comment and explicit visibility (null means unrestricted). Fixed adjustEstimate=leave; saved-template admission uses observed negative time delta and never defaults missing aggregate to zero. Reuse the bounded complete collection owner before effect and for same-parent absence after acknowledgement. Known receipt survives uncertain readback; no bare404 confirmation, replay, arbitrary estimate adjustment or author changes.

jira.edit.constraints: Validated supported fields, labels and links; formal-template/source enforcement and readback remain mandatory.

jira.edit-fields.constraints: Current editable metadata for one issue, projected into supported field kinds.

jira.epic.constraints: Selected board, sprint or epic with typed bounded projection and explicit native pagination where present; malformed/oversized pages fail closed. No ranking, board configuration mutation or implicit completion from item count.

jira.epic-issues.constraints: Selected board, sprint or epic with typed bounded projection and explicit native pagination where present; malformed/oversized pages fail closed. No ranking, board configuration mutation or implicit completion from item count.

jira.epic-move-issues.constraints: One bound epic and 1..50 unique issue keys; existing issue-template checks precede one POST and each issue epic membership is independently read. Batch failures remain uncertain; no replay or ranking.

jira.epic-update.constraints: Closed supported epic fields with existing issue-template admission; one bound ID/key and independent GET confirmation. No generic issue-field or workflow mutation.

jira.favourite-filters.constraints: Bounded favourite-filter array validated before local pagination; no filter creation or complete saved-view-family claim.

jira.filter.constraints: One visible filter ID with bounded owner/JQL/sharing facts; no filter creation, sharing mutation or private-default inference.

jira.filter-permission.constraints: One exact filter/permission identity with bounded selected sharing target and explicit view/edit facts. Unknown values are not inferred; no permission mutation or authorization widening.

jira.filter-permissions.constraints: One exact filter ID; validate the complete bounded native permission array before local startAt/maxResults pagination. Only selected typed sharing targets and explicit view/edit flags are projected; no permission mutation.

jira.filter-share-scope.constraints: No-argument read of the current GLOBAL/AUTHENTICATED/PRIVATE default filter-sharing scope only. A read does not change defaults, grant sharing authority or qualify private filter creation.

jira.get-comment.constraints: One issue/comment identity with bounded body, selected author/date metadata and explicit group/role visibility; unknown restrictions fail closed. No properties or comment deletion.

jira.group-members.constraints: Exact group-name selector, native startAt/maxResults up to50 and optional inactive users. Native scope includes the group and subgroups; it is not direct-only membership. Preserve validated native envelope and optional total, project bounded user identities, never follow nextPage or change membership.

jira.groups.constraints: Bounded native group query/maxResults picker; project group names and optional observed int32 total. No offset exists, so no invented continuation or silent result truncation. HTML/header/labels and undeclared exclusion/context selectors are omitted.

jira.issue.constraints: One issue with standard and bounded additional typed fields; comments are separately paginated.

jira.issue-link.constraints: One existing link ID with bounded type and linked-issue identity projection; no arbitrary link creation, replacement or deletion.

jira.issue-security-scheme.constraints: One exact native issue-security scheme; precise IDs, name/description and optional unique levels/default-level ID. Description character/byte and nested-array bounds fail closed. No role/user expansion, remote URLs, security assignment or effective-access calculation.

jira.issue-security-schemes.constraints: Bounded complete issueSecuritySchemes wrapper with local pagination. Scheme IDs and optional default-level/level facts are validated, with native admin visibility authoritative. Missing levels/defaults remain unknown, explicit empty lists remain observed, and no membership or configured-access claim is inferred.

jira.issue-type-scheme.constraints: One exact issue-type scheme GET with returned identity match and bounded optional native issue-type/default details. No association changes or guessed fields.

jira.issue-type-scheme-projects.constraints: Exact scheme association GET; native project array bounded and paged locally. Project identity/name/context only, no remote self URLs or association mutation.

jira.issue-type-schemes.constraints: Bounded local page of the native schemes collection; only fixed declared expand switches for issueTypes/defaultIssueType. No arbitrary expansions, fabricated missing nested data or scheme writes.

jira.issue-types.constraints: Create-metadata issue types for one selected project; does not expose global issue-type administration.

jira.link-types.constraints: Bounded visible link-type metadata for existing issue-link workflows; no link-type creation or administration.

jira.notification-scheme.constraints: One exact native notification scheme. Optional includeEvents exposes bounded documented events/recipient projections and an explicit availability marker; omitted event/recipient data is not fabricated as empty. Configured EmailAddress recipients may be projected under existing content policy; user email/self/avatar/HTML are omitted. No notifications sent or subscriptions changed.

jira.notification-schemes.constraints: Native notification page with max50 and verified start/max/isLast/optional-total envelope. Explicit includeEvents selects only fixed documented expansions; bounded event/template and twelve recipient kinds retain observed missing/empty distinctions. Configured recipient values remain user-facing local content, never audit bodies; no URL following, sending or inferred delivery.

jira.permission-grant.constraints: One exact grant within the selected scheme. Validate its precise native ID and bounded permission/holder fields; optional holder parameter stays absent when unknown. No permission grant/revoke, broad endpoint selection or inference of current-user access.

jira.permission-grants.constraints: One selected scheme with complete bounded native permissions wrapper and local pagination. Each unique grant retains id, permission and holder type/optional parameter; expanded users/groups/roles/fields and remote URLs are omitted. Configuration is not effective-current-user permission.

jira.permission-scheme.constraints: One exact native permission-scheme identity, bounded description and optional observed grants. Fixed includePermissions expansion only; precise numeric/string IDs, omitted/null nested permissions remain unknown and explicit empty lists remain empty. No arbitrary expansion, URL following or authority inference.

jira.permission-schemes.constraints: Bounded complete native permissionSchemes wrapper with local pagination; optional includePermissions emits only expand=permissions. Names, descriptions and observed grant/holder facts only; missing permissions stay unknown, not empty. No effective-user permission inference, expanded people, URLs or configuration writes.

jira.project.constraints: Bounded id/key/name and supported optional project fields for one selected project; no arbitrary project administration.

jira.project-avatars.constraints: One encoded project ID/key; bounded system/custom avatar metadata, complete source-array validation and local pagination. No project-avatar selection or image retrieval.

jira.project-notification-scheme.constraints: Read the selected canonical project before requesting its notification association through the observed numeric project ID. Reuse the same bounded scheme/event/recipient projection and fixed includeEvents switch; preserve native project-admin visibility and project context. No guessed association identity, URL following, configuration write or delivery claim.

jira.project-permissions.constraints: Global or selected-project permissions, at most 100 entries; unavailable permissions are not fabricated as false and oversized results are refused.

jira.project-type.constraints: One native accessible project-type result; no template, board or workflow configuration discovery.

jira.projects.constraints: Validated id/key/name projection only; locally paginated after a bounded unpaginated response; no project creation or settings.

jira.screen-available-fields.constraints: Exact screen available-fields GET with bounded local pagination and native field ID/name only. Availability metadata is not write authority; no arbitrary expansion or remote URL following.

jira.screen-tab-fields.constraints: Exact screen/tab fields GET with optional published projectKey. Bounded locally paged native field IDs/names; no editability/permission assertion or field mutation.

jira.screen-tabs.constraints: Exact screen tabs GET with published optional projectKey, bounded local pagination and native tab identity/name. No screen changes, remote page query or privileged fallback.

jira.search.constraints: Bounded opaque JQL with projected standard and selected typed fields; no POST search operation.

jira.security-level.constraints: One exact native security-level ID with bounded name/description. Native administrator visibility remains authoritative. No project assignment, membership inference, remote self URL or security change.

jira.sprint.constraints: Selected board, sprint or epic with typed bounded projection and explicit native pagination where present; malformed/oversized pages fail closed. No ranking, board configuration mutation or implicit completion from item count.

jira.sprint-create.constraints: Closed name/originBoardId and supported date/goal fields; the selected board must be readable and scrum before POST. Independent GET verifies identity, readable fields and future state.

jira.sprint-issues.constraints: Selected board, sprint or epic with typed bounded projection and explicit native pagination where present; malformed/oversized pages fail closed. No ranking, board configuration mutation or implicit completion from item count.

jira.sprint-move-issues.constraints: One selected open sprint and 1..50 unique issue keys; every issue passes existing template/source checks before the single POST, then each membership is independently read. Batch failures remain uncertain; no replay or ranking.

jira.sprint-update.constraints: Native partial POST only; omitted fields are preserved. Typed dates, current sprint state and legal transitions are checked; independent GET confirms requested fields. No PUT replacement or reopening closed sprints.

jira.sprints.constraints: Selected board, sprint or epic with typed bounded projection and explicit native pagination where present; malformed/oversized pages fail closed. No ranking, board configuration mutation or implicit completion from item count.

jira.system-avatars.constraints: Closed user/project/issuetype selector; bounded system-avatar identity/category and optional owner/selected metadata with local pagination. No image/remote URL following, temporary upload, crop or selection mutation.

jira.transition.constraints: One native available transition, validated fields and guarded readback; no workflow definition changes.

jira.transitions.constraints: Available transitions and required fields for one issue, without workflow administration.

jira.unvote.constraints: Connected-user-only vote DELETE, bound issue identity and independent hasVoted=false readback. Cannot remove another actor vote; already matching state is an explicit no-op, uncertainty is not replayed.

jira.unwatch.constraints: Connected-user-only watcher DELETE; actor resolved through the current credential, exact issue identity and independent isWatching=false readback. No caller-selected actor; matching state performs no write and unknown effects are not replayed.

jira.update-comment.constraints: Body-only update of one existing issue/comment. Preserve the independently read group/role visibility, refuse unknown restrictions, and confirm body plus restriction through an independent GET. No visibility editing, deletion or automatic replay.

jira.update-component.constraints: At least one supported name/description/lead/assignee field on the existing component; project identity remains bound and independently read back. No archive/delete/project move.

jira.update-project.constraints: One existing project with at least one supported name/lead/description/url/assignee field; key/type/scheme changes are not exposed. Current identity and requested readable fields require independent GET confirmation.

jira.update-version.constraints: At least one supported name/description/calendar date/released/archived field on an existing version; omitted values remain unchanged and its project cannot move. Independent GET confirmation; no delete/merge/replace.

jira.update-worklog.constraints: One exact issue/worklog PUT changing seconds, started and/or native comment; fixed adjustEstimate=leave. Observed visibility and unrequested fields retained and independently verified. Saved issue-template admission binds observed safe aggregate delta; inconsistent/unavailable relevant time fails closed. No visibility, author, issue relocation, deletion or arbitrary estimate adjustment.

jira.user.constraints: One native user selected by exactly one username or exact key, with optional includeDeleted. Native key/name are validated, username comparison preserves returned spelling, optional display/active/deleted fields stay unknown when absent. No email, avatar, group expansion, HTML or remote URL projection.

jira.user-avatars.constraints: Optional bounded username native query, otherwise current-user lookup; bounded system/custom metadata and local pagination. No avatar mutation, image retrieval or arbitrary user API.

jira.user-directory.constraints: One native streaming user page using an exact transient signed int64 cursor and bounded page size. Preserve native isLast/nextCursor; no total, numeric offset, stable cursor identity or remote nextPage following. A cursor page is returned whole or refused, never silently shortened.

jira.user-picker.constraints: Bounded native query/maxResults picker with fixed showAvatar=false; documented user identity fields and optional native int32 total only. No invented offset/continuation, header/HTML/avatar/email projection or undeclared exclude selector.

jira.users.constraints: Native username/name search with declared active/inactive switches and offset window strictly within first100. Project bounded key/name/display/flags; no fabricated total or complete-directory claim. Existing offset result budgeting resumes at the first unreturned item.

jira.validate-project-key.constraints: Native error collection is inspected; HTTP 200 alone does not establish validity. No locally invented organization-specific key policy.

jira.version.constraints: One exact positive decimal int64 resource ID and bounded supported field projection; remote self URLs are not trusted links.

jira.versions.constraints: One bound project; complete bounded native array is validated before local startAt/maxResults pagination. Oversized source arrays fail closed; no silent truncation.

jira.vote.constraints: Connected-user-only vote POST, bound issue identity and independent hasVoted readback. Native voting/permission restrictions remain authoritative; no actor selection or replay of unknown effects.

jira.votes.constraints: One bound issue voter GET with local bounded paging over visible returned people; native vote count, optional connected-user hasVoted and list completeness remain distinct. No email/self URLs or inferred hidden people/state.

jira.watch.constraints: Connected-user-only watching POST, with bound issue identity, current state inspection and independent isWatching readback. No model-selected username, no other-user operation, no replay of unknown effects; matching state performs no write.

jira.watchers.constraints: One bound issue watcher GET with local bounded paging over visible returned people; native count, optional connected-user isWatching and list completeness remain distinct. No email/self URLs or inferred hidden people/state; read permission is not write permission.

jira.workflow-scheme.constraints: One exact scheme GET; published optional returnDraftIfExists. Preserve returned scheme/draft ID separately from requested parent. Local page over union of present current/original mapping IDs; omitted maps/flags stay unknown. No user/self URL projection or administration writes.

jira.workflow-scheme-default.constraints: One published default-workflow GET with optional returnDraftIfExists. Validate the official DefaultBean workflow string rather than erroneous WorkflowSchemeBean response reference; do not invent returned draft state.

jira.workflow-scheme-draft.constraints: Explicit draft GET of a parent scheme; preserve native returned draft ID and observed flags, current/original mappings and local page. Does not create/publish a draft or infer active state from a selector.

jira.workflow-scheme-draft-default.constraints: One explicit draft default-workflow GET; bounded native DefaultBean workflow only, no assumed draft existence or mutation.

jira.workflow-scheme-draft-issue-type.constraints: One explicit draft/issue-type mapping GET; returned issueType must match selected ID. Bounded workflow projection, no mapping write or permission elevation.

jira.workflow-scheme-draft-workflows.constraints: Explicit draft workflow mapping GET; selected native object or unfiltered array per published name selector. Bounded unique mappings and local paging, omitted issue-type lists/default flags remain unknown.

jira.workflow-scheme-issue-type.constraints: One scheme/issue-type mapping GET with exact positive decimal IDs and optional published draft selector. Returned native issueType must match; bounded workflow string, no arbitrary workflow configuration.

jira.workflow-scheme-workflows.constraints: Published optional workflowName determines native selected-object versus unfiltered-array decoding. Exact selected name, bounded unique workflow/issue-type mappings, optional observed defaultMapping and local paging only. No arbitrary query or remote page assumption.

jira.worklog.constraints: One bound issue/worklog ID with bounded supported metadata; no worklog update/delete or permission inference from missing fields.

jira.worklogs.constraints: One issue with bounded native pagination and projected worklog identity/time/author/comment metadata. No worklog writes, estimates mutation or complete issue-history claim.
